summary.zh: 修复 ChatGPT/Claude 站点开关：停用当前站点后自动回退到官方订阅，不再报 Model not found。
summary.en: Fixed the ChatGPT/Claude site toggle: disabling the active site now falls back to the official subscription automatically instead of failing with 'Model not found'.

highlights.zh: 停用 ChatGPT/Claude 的当前站点时，自动切回官方订阅站点并写好配置，不再出现 Model not found 报错。
highlights.en: Disabling the active ChatGPT/Claude site now switches the agent back to the official subscription with the config written for you — no more 'Model not found' error.

highlights.zh: 被停用的站点保留在列表中（开关为关），随时可以一键重新启用。
highlights.en: The disabled site stays in the list with its toggle off, ready to be re-enabled at any time.

highlights.zh: 停用前自动生成配置快照，写入失败自动回滚，官方订阅写入同时清掉残留的第三方配置块。
highlights.en: A config snapshot is taken before disabling and restored automatically on failure; the fallback write also cleans up leftover third-party blocks in the agent config.
